name: Sunbury Walled Garden and Sunbury Gallery
summary: The restored 18th-century Walled Garden is a peaceful free place for a stroll. Within it, Sunbury Gallery has a café, changing exhibitions and the remarkable Millennium Embroidery, depicting the local community in thousands of stitches.
reasonToVisit: A free 18th-century walled garden with a gallery and café inside it
planningDetail: Garden and gallery entry is free; purchases and special events may charge
